p: A Japanese marketing and public relations team of three, two women and one man in navy business suits, standing together around a large blank presentation board with simple bar shapes and a blank campaign poster, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face floating beside them.
A tired marketer in a navy suit sitting at a desk and searching through piles of blank folders, printed web pages and a laptop with blank screen, rubbing her forehead, without characters.

A marketer in a navy suit sitting at a laptop with a blank screen and writing a blank draft together with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, who is holding a blank sheet of paper.
A busy young man in a navy suit hurrying to copy rows between a stack of blank sheets and a blank spreadsheet on a monitor, surrounded by piles of paper, without characters.

A market researcher woman in a navy suit at a desk comparing three blank web page cards, while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face hands her one tidy blank report with small link-shaped marks and a magnifying glass.

A marketer man and woman in navy suits brainstorming at a table with blank sticky notes and a light bulb shape, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face joining them and pointing to three blank idea cards.
A woman in a navy suit filling in a blank form on a tablet, and a blank form card moves along a simple path into a neat blank list board and a blank calendar card, a small gear shape beside it.

A marketer in a navy suit at a tidy shelf of blank folders and blank photo cards, while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face pulls out one blank card and places it into a neat blank layout sheet.

A copywriter woman in a navy suit at a desk with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face; one blank sheet branches into three blank cards shaped like an envelope, a smartphone and a browser window, all without characters.

A manager man in a navy suit reviewing one blank poster design on a large monitor and placing a simple check mark, with stacked blank versions of the design behind a neat folder and a small gear shape.
A woman in a navy suit at a seminar reception desk with a blank name list on a tablet, guests lining up, blank envelopes flying out to the guests, a small stage with a blank screen behind.
A person looking at a smartphone with a blank chat screen, and a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face comes out of a large blank website window, pointing to one blank page card.

An analyst man in a navy suit sorting many small blank comment cards into three neat colored trays together with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, one small odd card set aside in a separate tray.

A marketer woman in a navy suit at a desk looking at a blank dashboard monitor showing simple bar and line shapes without characters, several blank data sheets flowing into it from the left, a small gear shape, and a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face holding a blank sheet.
